effects.description: (3 items) Gain Minor Slayer, increasing damage done to monsters by 5%.
(5 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Reduces the cost of your Stamina abilities by 8%. When an enemy you have recently damaged dies, you restore 57-2454 Stamina and gain Major Expedition for |cffffff8|r seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30%.  These effects can occur once every second.
